Hidden gem restaurant found online! Coming with five friends was a huge surprise! 😍
Sep 2026 • Friends
😍Today, I watched it online with 4 friends who recommended it, and I didn't expect the whole experience to be so surprising! As soon as I entered, I thought the renovation was beautiful; the whole environment is very comfortable and clean, and it's relaxing to sit in. The food is incredibly high quality! The choices on the menu are overwhelming, we have too many to try and eat. The most important thing is that the quality of every dish is very high, absolutely no disappointment! But what I remember most is the service level, which was as good as a high-end hotel. The waiter was very attentive, and the food came out very quickly. When they knew we were from Hong Kong, they were still so enthusiastic about teaching us Vietnamese, it was so warm and happy!
This restaurant is definitely the most satisfying one on my trip to Da Nang this time. Next time I come to Da Nang, I will definitely bring other friends to visit again! 👍🏻💯

12 season kitchen
Aug 2026 • Family
I found this place after looking for a seafood buffet.
I felt that most seafood buffets in tourist areas were much the same, and after reading reviews of popular spots frequented by Koreans, I decided it wasn't worth visiting one in Da Nang; choosing this place instead turned out to be an excellent decision.
After I was seated, Elly served me a welcome drink—a flower tea that was delicious. When I asked if it was for sale before leaving, she explained how to make it and even gave me some dried flowers to take home; since today is the last day of my trip, this gesture ensures I’ll cherish wonderful memories of Da Nang.
The food was outstanding, and every shellfish dish was delicious. The staff promptly cleared away empty shells from the table and kept refilling my glass whenever the beer ran low.
Feeling like I needed a little more food, I ordered *banh xeo*; they gave me a moment to take a photo before taking it away to wrap the rolls for me, making it very convenient to eat.
While all the shops in Vietnam seemed friendly, I truly felt like a valued guest here.
Also, thank you, Elly, for taking such good care of me throughout the meal.
